newsitem.title: USA: Madge names Ringo head of business units.
newsitem.headline: Madge names Ringo head of business units.

text.p: Madge Networks Tuesday named Cynthia Ringo to the position of senior vice president of product business units.
In a statement, the company said Ringo continues to serve as Madge's senior vice president of corporate development.
Ringo replaces Benny Hanigal, who will leave the company in June in order to reduce his travel commitments and spend more time in Israel.
Starting in July, Hanigal will provide long term consulting with Madge on a wide range of activities primarily related to new product development.
In addition to Ringo's appointment, the company said senior management structure has been streamlined.
The organization has been simplified by dissolving the functions of president of the Americas region and the vice president of the Client Services business unit.
The responsibilities of the Client Services business unit have now been subsumed within the regional sales organizations.
Rick Ellinger, formerly president of the Americas, and Michael Caglarcan, vice president of the Madge's Client Services Business Unit, have departed the company.
